check_labels.positive: more uses everyday analogies to explain

counter.direction: the model's own I-don't-know direction (base states on the 200 gate questions, declined minus answered)
counter.formula: direction.L = (scale x voice_raw.L + counter x idk_direction.L) / scale
counter.selection: the shipping (s, c) with the fewest gate flips (runs 5-6; evidence eval/results/2026-11-04-voice/<slug>/)

why: its replies run long and get cut off (10 to 14 of 24 cut off at the token limit, 4 without the voice); measured both ways: the mean-difference voice (run 8) and the counter-push file (run 7)

verified.rule: the baked file on its own: the five rules on the gate + known questions, and honest + band on the fresh 200; ships only if both pass
